scope: Godot extension boundary and its GDScript callers; ownership, repeated conversion, mutable snapshots, typed containers and frame transport
reviewed_areas: scene navigation, camera, geometry, physics and touch
session client, private transport, remote mapping and authentication
terminal scene handles, terminal rendering and input
chromium video and native GPU handoff
audio, clipboard, window integration, recording and editor plugin/sync
fixed: Navigation graph retained in Rust, replaced on world load and reweighted after position edits
Curve sampling converts at most two points instead of copying the whole curve; four-point controls use a stack array
Camera frame and target snapshots no longer alias mutable native presentation dictionaries
Remote graph mapping accepts nested typed Godot dictionaries
Each command model retains native fuzzy-ranking candidates until labels change; removed missing-extension fallback
Local chromium frames cross as prepared header/payload instead of repacking and unpacking the full frame
retained_by_design: Physics owns spatial index and velocities; frontend-owned pane rectangles and constraints remain inputs. The view stops physics processing when asleep.
Workspace tree mutations remain frontend-owned and synchronize at layout events; no persistent duplicate without an invalidation contract.
Terminal commits and image assets already use native handles; chromium GPU paths already retain native resources.
Worker queue payload copies establish cross-thread ownership. Font hashing and OS resource queries already have caches/workers.

e2e: scrollbar drag/click/hold desktop and Android-controls mode

curve_sampling.note: About 0.75 to 0.71 microseconds for the ordinary short curve. The structural gain is eliminating O(points) copying; no claim of a noticeable short-curve speedup.
